content: How should I calculate the Communication Security Risk (CSR)? What columns and formula should I use?

args.sql:
SELECT 
    ra.riskregistry,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (ra.txchainlen * 10) + (ra.linkedtxcount * 5) + (ra.fraudprob * 100) - (ra.profilecomplete * 0.5) - (ra.idverifyscore * 0.5)
    AS numeric), 2) AS chain_risk_value,
    t.txregistry,
    t.payamtusd,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (c.iptally * 5) + (c.tornodecount * 2) + (CASE c.vpnflag WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END * 30) + (c.brwsrunique / 10.0) + (c.susppatscore * 3.0) + (c.riskindiccount * 4)
    AS numeric), 2) AS csr
FROM riskanalysis ra
JOIN transactions t ON ra.txref = t.txregistry
JOIN communication c ON ra.commref = c.commregistry
WHERE (ra.txchainlen * 10) + (ra.linkedtxcount * 5) + (ra.fraudprob * 100) - (ra.profilecomplete * 0.5) - (ra.idverifyscore * 0.5) > 150
AND ra.wallage < 30 AND ra.wallturnrt > 5 AND ra.linkedtxcount >= 3
ORDER BY chain_risk_value DESC;

    AS numeric), 2) AS chain_risk_value,
    t.txregistry,

    ROUND(CAST(
        (c.iptally * 5) + (c.tornodecount * 2) + (CASE c.vpnflag WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END * 30) + (c.brwsrunique / 10.0) + (c.susppatscore * 3.0) + (c.riskindiccount * 4)
    AS numeric), 2) AS csr
